title: Produce Grading — Standards & Specifications (Master SOP for Quality Inspectors)
approval: none stated (no revision, approver, signature or effective date) — imported awaiting QA approval (OD-43)
override_note: Any override of the maximum defect tolerance per consignment will be communicated between Commercial and Packing House management (p.3, pp.7–19) — OD-47.

procedure.en: Check packaging: food-grade, clean, intact and carefully stacked; labels present
Assess appearance: colour, gloss, skin, stem/calyx and shape against the product description
Cut & taste: internal flesh and seeds; sensory check for flavour, texture and aroma
Measure size: diameter, length or weight against the grade and customer ranges
Sort defects: classify each defective unit as Minor, Major or Unacceptable
Grade or reject: compare defect % with grade tolerances

rule: A lot meets a grade only if each defect category is within that grade's maximum tolerance. Any unacceptable defect above the limit means rejection. Exception: for Tomato and Cherry Tomato, live insects are evaluated internally and are not an automatic rejection (p.4, C-05).

packaging: Food-grade material, delivered clean and intact
Carefully stacked so product beneath is not damaged
Peppers: 5 kg carton with lid recommended
chemicals: Pre- and post-harvest chemicals must be registered and approved for use in Jordan
Residues: Jordan and Codex standards (tomatoes, peppers)
Residues: Global GAP standards (eggplant, mini cucumber)
food_safety: All products may be eaten raw without peeling
Product may therefore be periodically tested for bacteria
Cherry tomato is also tested for chemical residue

tomato_scale.en: Stage 1 = fully green → stage 6 = fully red-ripe; accepted stage 3–5; stage 6 accepted with conditions

items: Draw a representative sample from every consignment
Check packaging first: dirty, collapsed or unsuitable packaging is an unacceptable defect
Grade colour / maturity and size (or weight) into Premium / G1 or G2
Confirm the product meets its quality description: appearance, internal, sensory, shape
Record each defect as Minor, Major or Unacceptable and calculate % per category
Accept the grade only if every defect category is within tolerance
When packing for Tesco, Thanet Earth, LSS, Abay, DBS, Export or DC, apply that customer's limits
